for capture in system['captures']:
    key=capture['width']; keyboard=capture['keyboard']; owner=capture['owned_scroller']['after'];
    print(key, {'owner':owner, 'focus': {name: keyboard[name]['focus'] for name in ('first','middle','final')}, 'pointer':capture['pointer'], 'overflow':(capture['page']['document_scroll_width'],capture['page']['body_scroll_width'])})
